name: FoxLpBondsPool pre-swap spot pricing over-mints FOX
summary: stake() prices the entire USDT bond from the FOX/USDT pair before swapping half of that same deposit through the shallow pair. It then mints FOX-denominated bond and referral inventory from the stale pre-swap quote. One financed call minted endogenous FOX and sold it back into the pair, depleting its liquid USDT reserve.
notes: The proxy constructor selected 0x58e2a853bb14e46befd3148bd4280370fea4655a in Upgraded log 296 and immediately delegatecalled initialize, whose immutable storage choices bind BSC USDT, FOX, PancakeSwap Router v2 and pair 0xaab18bcdee287aea288c0560612caadf7c328803. This is the only Upgraded event through the incident. The EIP-1967 slot and all pricing-path and pair getters are unchanged pre-incident, and the implementation exposes no setters for those values.

The FOX/USDT pair 0xaab18bcdee287aea288c0560612caadf7c328803 sent 482652334.587313528253588625 USDT and received 240987392.768398210827166510 plus 240987392.768398210827166511 USDT in the loss receipt, so its gross scarce-asset depletion is 677549.050517106599255604 USDT. Archive balances agree exactly: 2786697.198864505157273333 before and 2109148.148347398558017729 after the block; no other transaction in the block touches the pair's USDT or FOX. The pair received net 2108546.337965754947092948 FOX, principally from FOX minted during the same call, so that endogenous inventory is consideration but not an independently scarce loss offset. Thirty-one external financing pools supplied 481974785.536796421654333021 USDT and received 482539358.468560385626356388, an aggregate 564572.931763963972023367-USDT gain outside the Fox victim entity. The attacker retained 112976.118753142627232237 USDT, explaining the smaller proceeds-based seed figure. The canonical BNB Chain bridge list identifies this 18-decimal contract as BSC USDT; DefiLlama observed $0.9984824445632876 nine seconds before the receipt. Exact decimal multiplication is $676520.8322718550395813237978550269637104.
